# MVP Plan — {{APP_NAME}}

*The scope contract. Claude works ONLY inside the current milestone. Generated by `/new-app`, ticked as tasks complete.*

**Current milestone:** M0

## M0 — Scaffold

- [ ] Public-only product strategy evidence complete; deterministic Opportunity Score = `go`; honest three-second demo/video-ready state defined
- [ ] `PRODUCT.md`, product map, growth plan, security model, architecture, and design direction agree
- [ ] `/factory-setup` doctor green; operator profile complete; native status window follows `.factory/run-state.json`
- [ ] Project scaffold ({{STACK}}) + git init + first commit
- [ ] Firebase projects `{{APP_SLUG}}-dev` / `{{APP_SLUG}}-prod`, `.firebaserc` aliases, emulators running
- [ ] Firebase iOS/web registrations + Vite public/support/privacy/terms/admin site + Hosting dev/prod
- [ ] Admin bootstrap Functions (`ADMIN_EMAILS`, App Check, `admin` claim) deployed and verified without raw user CRUD
- [ ] Cloudflare R2 dev/prod asset buckets + read-only Worker deployed; no client write credential/route
- [ ] FCM/APNs infrastructure configured; runtime permission remains off unless PRODUCT.md names a legitimate notification value
- [ ] Firestore rules: deny-by-default baseline deployed to dev
- [ ] RevenueCat SDK configured (entitlement `pro`, offering `default`), sandbox products created
- [ ] i18n skeleton scaffolded for the default 9-locale set (tr, en, ar, ja, zh-Hans, ru, es, pt-BR, de — `docs/playbooks/localization.md`) — no hardcoded strings from day one
- [ ] Design tokens + component foundation installed per `docs/playbooks/design.md`
- [ ] Analytics + Crashlytics wired; `onboarding_start` test event visible in DebugView
- [ ] Crashlytics non-fatal + forced-test-crash verification recorded on a dev/TestFlight build; Performance Monitoring traces cover launch and the core action
- [ ] Provider connection doctor reports Firebase, RevenueCat MCP/OAuth and (when selected) fal.ai status without persisting secrets
- [ ] Anonymous auth on first launch
- [ ] ASC auth doctor green; bundle/signing/app record known; RevenueCat/ASC catalog audit plan approved

**Done when:** app boots on simulator with emulator-backed Firebase; web/admin, Hosting, R2, push and ASC/RC skeletons are verified; no secret is stored in repo or factory state.

## M1 — Core value system, end to end

<!-- 3–5 tasks; add lines as needed. The interview's wedge belongs here. -->
<!-- Sequencing doctrine: M1 ships the gotcha (acquisition) feature exceptionally well.
     The viral feature acquires; the useful feature retains. Retention features are
     chosen later from observed churn evidence (M4 / growth loop), not invented up
     front. First-embarrassing-version rule: at v1 only the gotcha moment and the
     money path (onboarding → paywall) must be excellent; every other surface may be
     minimal. Minimal ≠ broken — every shipped screen still passes the required-states,
     design-QA, and security gates; "minimal" bounds scope (fewer screens, fewer
     options), never the quality of what ships. -->
- [ ] {{CORE_TASK_1}}
- [ ] {{CORE_TASK_2}}
- [ ] {{CORE_TASK_3}}
- [ ] Core loop instrumented: `core_action_{{CORE_ACTION}}` fires with params
- [ ] Recovery system: empty, loading, offline, rate-limit, provider-failure, and retry states are designed and tested
- [ ] Retention loop selected only when it reinforces the core job (saved history/progress, reminder, or shareable result); its trigger and success metric are documented; prefer selecting it from observed churn evidence once available
- [ ] If the core action is AI/media: server proxy, quota/credit guard, idempotency key, cancellation, and automatic failed-job refund are verified
- [ ] Meets the "exceptionally well" bar in PRODUCT.md

**Done when:** a new user can complete the core action repeatedly, recover from expected failure, and return for a value-backed reason—without crashes, jank, or dead ends.

## M2 — Onboarding + paywall (the money path)

- [ ] Onboarding flow per `docs/playbooks/onboarding.md` (value demo → personalization → priming → paywall)
- [ ] Paywall per `docs/playbooks/paywall.md` (RevenueCat Paywalls, compliance block, Restore)
- [ ] Offerings prefetched at onboarding start — paywall renders instantly
- [ ] Full funnel events: `onboarding_start` → `onboarding_step_<n>` → `onboarding_complete` → `paywall_view` → `trial_start`/`purchase`
- [ ] Sandbox purchase + Restore verified for every package

**Done when:** funnel is measurable end-to-end in Firebase DebugView + RC sandbox dashboard.

## M3 — Polish, gates, store, release

- [ ] M1 and M2 acceptance is recorded; release-candidate UI/content is stable, memory docs match the build, and final store creative work is unblocked
- [ ] Engineering-quality gate passes; slow/offline/provider-failure and CI evidence recorded
- [ ] Security-model/data/SDK/permission/privacy parity, IDOR/rate-limit/upload negatives, deployed CORS/headers, history secret scan, and category-specific review evidence pass
- [ ] `docs/checklists/performance.md` budgets measured and met
- [ ] `docs/checklists/security.md` gates pass (rules diff, secret scan, App Check)
- [ ] Design QA: polish bar on every screen (`docs/playbooks/design.md`)
- [ ] Store assets via `/store-assets` (metadata all locales + captioned screenshots generated & validated)
- [ ] `/ship` go/no-go green → TestFlight → submission per `docs/checklists/release.md`
- [ ] Internal TestFlight group/tester distribution completed through `asc`; App Store review submission still awaits separate human approval
- [ ] If native Android parity is selected after iOS ships, `/port-android` owns its separate scope, state, quality gates, and Play delivery; it does not expand this iOS MVP silently

## M4 — Published app operations (first 90 days)

- [ ] `/operate-app --mode=plan` establishes release health, support/review themes, social listening sources, content pillars, landing-page baseline, and measurement ownership
- [ ] Weekly operating loop runs: Crashlytics/ASC/RevenueCat/Firebase health → reviews/support → X/Instagram/TikTok/Reddit research → content drafts → one measured growth experiment serving the current MRR-ladder rung (`docs/growth-plan.md`)
- [ ] Platform-native creative packs use real product proof and include asset/shot prompts, disclosure, accessibility text, CTA, tracking link, and stop condition
- [ ] Landing page matches the shipped build, design tokens, App Store metadata, privacy claims, and analytics consent; mobile performance/accessibility proof recorded
- [ ] Every publish/site/notification/review-response mutation is previewed and explicitly approved; results feed the next evidence window

**Done when:** this milestone becomes the recurring operating cadence. It is never “finished”; pause or change cadence when evidence, budget, or product strategy requires it.
